test_get_managed_system_homebrew: test the get_managed_system function to return 'Homebrew' when HERMES_MANAGED env var is set to 'homebrew'
test_recommended_update_command_homebrew: test the recommended_update_command function to return 'brew upgrade hermes-agent' when HERMES_MANAGED is set to 'homebrew'
test_recommended_update_command_defaults: test the recommended_update_command function to return 'hermes update' when HERMES_MANAGED env var is not set
test_format_managed_message: test the format_managed_message function to include 'managed by Homebrew' and the recommended update command in the output message
test_cmd_update_blocks_managed: test the cmd_update function to block execution and print an error when HERMES_MANAGED is set to 'homebrew'
